annotations.title: Dining, wellness, services, activities and more

description: Facts from one hotel page no other tool covers: dining (chefsTable, alte-gaststube, fondue, bar, weinkeller), wellness (wellness, massagen, private-spa), services (halbpension = half board, familien, shuttle-transfer, ski-service), activities (freeride, heli, skitouren, langlauf, wandern, biken, golf), opening dates (oeffnungszeiten), arrival (anreise), history (geschichte), company stays (firmen). Leave out topic for the list. Returns facts (prices, hours), sections, FAQ, URL.

language.description: Language of texts and links: de, nl, en. Default de.

topic.description: Topic id, e.g. chefsTable, wellness, halbpension, freeride, oeffnungszeiten. Leave out for the list.

name: get_topic

code.description: Error code when ok is false, e.g. VALIDATION, NOT_FOUND, UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: Readable error message when ok is false.

ok.description: true on success; false with code and message on an error.
